stemMarkdown: A is 4 times as efficient as B. Working together, they complete a job in 8 days. In how many days can A alone complete the job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Let B's rate be $r$ per day; A's rate is $4r$. Combined rate $= (4+1)r = 1/8$, so $r = \dfrac{1}{5\times8}$. A's rate $= 4r$, so A alone takes $\dfrac{1}{4r} = \dfrac{5\times8}{4} = 10.00$ days.
